Just finished this game, and jumped straight to writing this review. I will try to be relatively spoiler free, so no worries on that. 

To start, im a huge Warhammer 40k fan. Ive played all the RTS games, the MMO, and even tried my hand at the boardgame. I picked this game up preeetty late after its release, grabbing it on a 75% off sale. Let me say, it was worth it from a fan standpoint. Yet if this is your first Warhammer game, or dont know much about the factions or any general backstory, you might not exactly understand most of the game. Hell, even if you're a fan, you'll notice some things are a little out of place or dont make sense. Ill touch on that, but first the pros and cons.

Pros:
- TONS of action and blood. 
- Plenty of enemies to kill on screen
- Factions present like Imperial Guard, Orks, SpaceMarines and Chaos.
- Good story length (roughly 7 hours)
- Challenging sequences and fights.
- People still play the multiplayer, and its fun.
- Different weapons to choose from, so you can pick and choose what you like.
- Very WH40k esque scenery and locations.
- 3rd Person with aiming and melee was done nicely and smoothly.

Cons:
- The hordes of enemies coming at you are just clones of one another. Same models for each "class" of enemy (Slugga Boyz, Shoota Boyz, ect.)
- So. Many. Elevators. Seriously.
- The story can be predicted easily, and leaves out or throws away tons of relevant details.
- Some enemies (im looking at you, Chaos) you've never seen in a WH40k game before. Trust me, its weird.
- Very linear. Lots of hallways in certain chapters. You can never choose another "path" to get to the objective, theres literally only 1 way there.
- You wont see any other Space Marines until a certain point in the game. Even then you fight with them for a measly 5 minutes. I would have loved to fight alongside them for longer in more badass locations.

I wont go into story details. If you are a WH40k fan, get this game on sale. Its sooo worth it so play as a singular Space Marine. You'll die occasionally, even in Normal difficulty. The story was kind of meh after the first half but oh well. It has potential for a sequel.
If you are looking for a mindless Hack and slash + shoot 'em up game then this is the game for you.

In fielty to the God-Emperor, our undying Lord, and by the grace of the Golden Throne...
I declare reverence towards the Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine game.

I hereby sign the purchase order of an entire Collection Pack and condemn a dozen DLCs to entertainment.

May Imperial Justice account in all balance. The Emperor protects!

++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

It is human nature to seek culpability in time of sales.

It is a sign of strength to cry out against discounts, rather than to bow one's head and succumb.

Inevitably many shall fault the hands upon the sword which fell my wallet, the Steamus Valvecus.

But Valve merely performs the duty of its office, to further fear them is redundant, to hate them - despisable.

Those more sensible will place responsibility with those who forced the hands of Valve.

With some fortune they may foster this hatred into purpose and further rule their own fate by coming to the Emperor's service.

Yet, ultimately, it was I who set these events into motion, with a single click from my button - Purchase Now.
